statements.english: Okay , you go call him
statements.chinese: 好的，你去叫他吧。

statements.english: l saw it
statements.chinese: 我看见了。

statements.english: I don't know what are you talking about ?
statements.chinese: 我不知道你在说什么？

what.definition: 什么（关系代词的作用说明）

are.definition: be（现在时复数）: 构成现在进行时

statements.english: l'm talking about what you already know but won't admit
statements.chinese: 我说的是你心知肚明却不愿承认的事。

statements.english: You know , you love her again . You re-love her
statements.chinese: 要知道，你又爱上她了。你重新爱上了她。

statements.english: l do not re-love her
statements.chinese: 我不再爱她了。

re-love.definition: 重新爱（短语动词）: 再次爱上

statements.english: l can't believe you won't just admit it
statements.chinese: 我真不敢相信你就是不肯承认。

statements.english: Okay , just promise me you won't do anything stupid
statements.chinese: 好吧，答应我别做傻事。

statements.english: We're just friends now , okay ?
statements.chinese: 我们现在只是朋友了，好吗？

statements.english: Why would l do anything stupid ?
statements.chinese: 我怎么会做蠢事呢？

would.definition: would（过去式）: 表示假设或意愿

statements.english: Well , the apartment is already subletted
statements.chinese: 嗯，这间公寓已经转租出去了。

statements.english: I mean this is just hopeless . l'll never gonna find anything
statements.chinese: 我是说这简直没救了。我永远都找不到任何东西。

statements.english: You can live with me
statements.chinese: 你可以和我一起住。

statements.english: - What ? - What ?!
statements.chinese: 什么？- 什么？！

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: Oh , my god . Are you serious ?
statements.chinese: 天啊，你是认真的吗？

statements.english: l would love to live with you , Ross
statements.chinese: 罗斯，我很想和你一起生活

statements.english: That's great . Thank you
statements.chinese: 太好了。谢谢。

statements.english: l'm just glad , you know , l could help you out
statements.chinese: 你知道的，能帮上忙我就很开心了。

statements.english: Wow , l'm so happy for you guys
statements.chinese: 哇，我真为你们感到高兴。

statements.english: This is so , so , not stupid
statements.chinese: 这一点儿也不蠢。

statements.english: Ross , Ross , you have no idea what this means to me
statements.chinese: Ross，Ross，你根本不知道这对我意味着什么。

means.definition: mean（第三人称单数）: 意味着

statements.english: l mean , I was gonna be homeless
statements.chinese: 我是说，我差点就无家可归了。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

statements.english: You just saved me . You're my hero
statements.chinese: 你刚刚救了我。你是我的英雄。

statements.english: Hero ? l don't know . Well , all right
statements.chinese: 英雄？我不知道。好吧，行吧。

statements.english: l have to go tell Monica what a wonderful brother she has
statements.chinese: 我得去告诉Monica她有个多么棒的哥哥。

statements.english: Oh , please
statements.chinese: 哦，拜托。

statements.english: You're gonna say things now , aren't you ?
statements.chinese: 你现在有话要说，对吧？

statements.english: No . No , l won't
statements.chinese: 不。不，我不会。

statements.english: But l should tell you this
statements.chinese: 但我得告诉你这件事。

statements.english: This is the exact same thing happened to my roommate , Denise
statements.chinese: 我的室友Denise也遇到了完全相同的事情。

statements.english: She moved in with a guy who was secretly married to her
statements.chinese: 她和一个暗中与她有婚姻关系的男人同居了。

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

statements.english: He said he didn't love her , but he really did
statements.chinese: 他说他不爱她，但实际上他深爱着她。

statements.english: And it just blew up
statements.chinese: 结果它就突然爆火了。

statements.english: And that's how she ended up living with me
statements.chinese: 就这样，她最终和我住在了一起。

statements.english: Okay , that's a lie
statements.chinese: 好吧，那是骗人的。

statements.english: Listen , l'm sorry about before
statements.chinese: 听着，我为之前的事感到抱歉。

statements.english: l don't need to have a game room
statements.chinese: 我不需要游戏室。

statements.english: I mean , when I was a kid , l only played those games
statements.chinese: 我是说，我小时候只玩过那些游戏

statements.english: because l couldn't get girls
statements.chinese: 因为我追不到女孩。

statements.english: Now l can get- -
statements.chinese: 现在我终于可以——

statements.english: Now l have you
statements.chinese: 现在我抓住你了。

statements.english: No , not that l think l have you ..
statements.chinese: 不，我并不认为我拥有你...

statements.english: ... or think of you as property in any sort of way
statements.chinese: ...或以任何方式将你视为财产。

think.definition: think（短语动词原型）: 认为

statements.english: - l see women ....- Stop it , Chandler
statements.chinese: 我看到女人们....- 别说了，Chandler。

statements.english: l'm sorry too
statements.chinese: 我也很抱歉。

statements.english: - Really ? - Yeah . Oh , yes
statements.chinese: - 真的吗？ - 是啊。哦，没错。

statements.english: Listen , we don't have to made it a guest room
statements.chinese: 听着，我们没必要把它弄成客房。

statements.english: We can think of something to do with the room together
statements.chinese: 我们可以一起想想怎么布置这个房间。

statements.english: That's a great idea
statements.chinese: 这是个好主意。

statements.english: We can easily think of a way for us both to enjoy the room
statements.chinese: 我们可以轻松想出一个让我们俩都能享受这个房间的办法。
